description_full: Glenveagh Properties PLC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and sale of houses and apartments for private buyers, local authorities, and the private rental sector in Ireland. It operates through Homebuilding and Partnerships segments. The company develops own-door single-family properties in Dublin, the Greater Dublin Area, and Cork; and suburban single-family focused and urban multi-family focused properties. It also provides financing and manufacturing services. Glenveagh Properties PLC was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Maynooth, Ireland.

financial_summary: GLENVEAGH PROPERTIES PLC is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $1.5B market cap on $1.0B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +15% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

Returns on capital run at 11% against a 7% cost of capital, a 4-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, and 20% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.

The business throws off $97M in free cash flow — roughly 9 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, with adequate 0.93× cash conversion.
On the balance sheet, leverage is comfortably conservative at 1.1× net debt/EBITDA, and interest coverage runs at 7.8×.

Management returns a meaningful 5.6% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 6.3% of the shares, and within its sector the business captures 2.0× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.

growth: Revenue has compounded at 15.5% over 3 years.

own: Insiders own 6.3%, meaningful skin in the game, and institutions hold 74%.

The company is founder-led, which often keeps management aligned with long-term owners.
